```{=html}
<style>
/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Pair Notebook walkthrough — a hand-drawn "two windows" animation.
   Everything is scoped under .pn-* so the site theme is left alone.
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.pn-stage {
  --pn-ink: #2c2a3a;
  --pn-ink-soft: #6b6880;
  --pn-paper: #fffdf8;
  --pn-accent: #593196;
  --pn-accent-soft: #f0e9fb;
  --pn-amber: #c2410c;
  --pn-term-bg: #221f30;
  --pn-term-fg: #ece9f5;
  --pn-hand: "Bradley Hand", "Chalkboard SE", "Comic Sans MS", "Segoe Print", "Comic Neue", cursive;
  --pn-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace;

  position: relative;
  margin: 1.6rem 0 2.2rem;
  padding: 0.9rem 0.9rem 1.1rem;
  color: var(--pn-ink);
  background-color: var(--pn-paper);
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(89, 49, 150, 0.055) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(89, 49, 150, 0.055) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 24px 24px;
  border: 2px solid var(--pn-ink);
  border-radius: 14px 7px 16px 9px / 9px 16px 7px 14px;
  box-shadow: 4px 5px 0 -1px rgba(44, 42, 58, 0.18);
}

/* ---- control bar ---- */
.pn-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}
.pn-step-label {
  font-family: var(--pn-hand);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  flex: 1 1 12rem;
  min-width: 0;
}
.pn-step-label .pn-num {
  display: inline-block;
  min-width: 1.5rem;
  margin-right: 0.35rem;
  padding: 0 0.35rem;
  text-align: center;
  color: #fff;
  background: var(--pn-accent);
  border-radius: 12px 6px 12px 6px / 6px 12px 6px 12px;
}
.pn-dots { display: flex; gap: 0.3rem; }
.pn-dot {
  width: 13px; height: 13px; padding: 0;
  border: 1.6px solid var(--pn-ink);
  border-radius: 60% 40% 55% 45% / 45% 55% 40% 60%;
  background: transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.pn-dot[aria-current="true"] { background: var(--pn-accent); border-color: var(--pn-accent); }
.pn-btn {
  font-family: var(--pn-hand);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  line-height: 1.1;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.6rem;
  color: var(--pn-ink);
  background: #fff;
  border: 1.8px solid var(--pn-ink);
  border-radius: 14px 6px 14px 6px / 6px 14px 6px 14px;
  box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 -0.5px rgba(44, 42, 58, 0.35);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.pn-btn:hover { background: var(--pn-accent-soft); }
.pn-btn:active { transform: translate(1px, 1px); box-shadow: none; }

/* ---- the desk: two windows side by side ---- */
.pn-desk {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 0.9rem;
  align-items: start;
}
.pn-win {
  position: relative;
  border: 2px solid var(--pn-ink);
  border-radius: 12px 6px 14px 8px / 8px 14px 6px 12px;
  box-shadow: 3px 4px 0 -1px rgba(44, 42, 58, 0.25);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.pn-win-term { transform: rotate(-0.45deg); background: var(--pn-term-bg); }
.pn-win-nb   { transform: rotate(0.35deg);  background: #fff; }
.pn-win-title {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem;
  font-family: var(--pn-hand);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem;
  border-bottom: 1.8px solid var(--pn-ink);
}
.pn-win-term .pn-win-title { color: #cdc7e0; background: #322c46; }
.pn-win-nb   .pn-win-title { color: var(--pn-ink); background: var(--pn-accent-soft); }
.pn-lights { display: inline-flex; gap: 3px; }
.pn-lights i {
  width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1.3px solid rgba(44, 42, 58, 0.55);
  background: #d8d3e6;
}
.pn-body {
  height: 340px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  scrollbar-width: none;
  padding: 0.6rem 0.7rem 1rem;
}
.pn-body::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
.pn-term-body { font-family: var(--pn-mono); font-size: 0.78rem; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--pn-term-fg); }
.pn-nb-body   { background: var(--pn-paper); }

/* ---- terminal lines ---- */
.pn-line { margin: 0 0 0.45rem; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; }
.pn-who { font-weight: 700; margin-right: 0.4rem; }
.pn-line-tutor .pn-who { color: #f2b544; }
.pn-line-you   .pn-who { color: #86c5ff; }
.pn-line-sys   { color: #8f89a6; font-style: italic; }
.pn-line-cmd   { color: #b9f0d0; }
.pn-line-ok    { color: #9ce0b6; }
.pn-cursor {
  display: inline-block; width: 0.55em; height: 1em;
  margin-left: 1px; vertical-align: -0.15em;
  background: #86c5ff;
  animation: pn-blink 1s step-end infinite;
}
@keyframes pn-blink { 50% { opacity: 0; } }

/* ---- notebook cells ---- */
.pn-cell {
  position: relative;
  margin: 0 0 0.7rem;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.65rem 0.6rem;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1.8px solid var(--pn-ink);
  border-radius: 10px 5px 12px 6px / 6px 12px 5px 10px;
  box-shadow: 2px 3px 0 -1px rgba(44, 42, 58, 0.18);
  animation: pn-pop 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1) both;
}
.pn-cell:nth-child(even) { transform: rotate(-0.3deg); }
.pn-cell:nth-child(odd)  { transform: rotate(0.25deg); }
@keyframes pn-pop { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px) scale(0.97); } }
.pn-cell-tag {
  font-family: var(--pn-hand);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  color: var(--pn-accent);
  margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
}
.pn-cell-title { font-family: var(--pn-hand); font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 700; margin: 0 0 0.2rem; }
.pn-cap { font-family: var(--pn-hand); font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--pn-ink-soft); margin-top: 0.25rem; }
.pn-quote {
  font-family: var(--pn-hand);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  padding-left: 0.5rem;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--pn-accent);
}

/* ---- network sketch ---- */
/* Capped so the SVG's own type stays close to the notebook's type size. */
.pn-svg { display: block; width: 100%; max-width: 310px; height: auto; margin: 0 auto; }
.pn-edge { stroke: var(--pn-ink); stroke-width: 2.2; stroke-linecap: round; fill: none;
  stroke-dasharray: 240; stroke-dashoffset: 240; animation: pn-draw 0.4s ease forwards; }
@keyframes pn-draw { to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } }
.pn-node { fill: var(--pn-accent); stroke: var(--pn-ink); stroke-width: 1.8;
  opacity: 0; animation: pn-fade 0.3s ease forwards; }
@keyframes pn-fade { to { opacity: 1; } }
.pn-nolabel { font-family: var(--pn-hand); font-size: 11px; fill: var(--pn-ink); }

/* ---- slider widget ---- */
.pn-slider { max-width: 310px; margin: 0.45rem auto 0.2rem; }
.pn-track {
  position: relative; height: 8px; margin: 0.9rem 0.4rem 0.5rem;
  background: #efecf6; border: 1.6px solid var(--pn-ink);
  border-radius: 8px 4px 8px 4px / 4px 8px 4px 8px;
}
.pn-knob {
  position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 0;
  width: 20px; height: 20px; margin: -10px 0 0 -10px;
  background: var(--pn-accent); border: 1.8px solid var(--pn-ink);
  border-radius: 58% 42% 50% 50% / 50% 50% 42% 58%;
  transition: left 0.12s linear;
}
.pn-readout { font-family: var(--pn-mono); font-size: 0.72rem; display: flex; gap: 0.9rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.pn-readout b { font-weight: 700; }
.pn-marker { stroke: var(--pn-amber); stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-dasharray: 3 3; }
.pn-curve-L { stroke: var(--pn-accent); stroke-width: 2.4; fill: none; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.pn-curve-C { stroke: var(--pn-amber); stroke-width: 2.4; fill: none; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.pn-axis { stroke: var(--pn-ink); stroke-width: 1.4; }

/* ---- drop box + photo ---- */
.pn-drop {
  position: relative; height: 92px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-family: var(--pn-hand); font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--pn-ink-soft);
  border: 2.2px dashed var(--pn-ink);
  border-radius: 12px 6px 14px 7px / 7px 14px 6px 12px;
  background: #fbf8ff;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.pn-photo {
  position: absolute; width: 118px;
  border: 2px solid var(--pn-ink); background: #fff;
  box-shadow: 2px 3px 0 -1px rgba(44, 42, 58, 0.3);
  transform: translateY(-120px) rotate(-9deg);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: transform 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.3, 1.25, 0.6, 1), opacity 0.3s ease;
}
.pn-photo.pn-in { transform: translateY(0) rotate(-4deg); opacity: 1; }
.pn-drop .pn-hint { transition: opacity 0.3s ease; }
.pn-drop.pn-filled .pn-hint { opacity: 0; }
.pn-send {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.3rem;
  margin-top: 0.45rem;
  font-family: var(--pn-hand); font-size: 0.8rem;
  padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem;
  background: #fff; color: var(--pn-ink);
  border: 1.8px solid var(--pn-ink);
  border-radius: 14px 6px 14px 6px / 6px 14px 6px 14px;
  box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 -0.5px rgba(44, 42, 58, 0.4);
}
.pn-send.pn-press { transform: translate(1.5px, 1.5px); box-shadow: none; background: var(--pn-accent); color: #fff; }
.pn-send.pn-done  { background: var(--pn-accent-soft); }

/* ---- session record ---- */
.pn-rec { font-family: var(--pn-hand); font-size: 0.8rem; margin: 0.1rem 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.pn-rec li { margin: 0.12rem 0; }
.pn-rec .pn-tick { color: var(--pn-accent); font-weight: 700; }

/* ---- the pointing hand ---- */
.pn-pointer {
  position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0;
  font-size: 1.35rem; line-height: 1;
  opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
  transition: transform 0.65s cubic-bezier(0.3, 0.8, 0.4, 1), opacity 0.25s ease;
  z-index: 5;
}
.pn-pointer.pn-on { opacity: 1; }

/* ---- footer note ---- */
.pn-note {
  font-family: var(--pn-hand);
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
  padding-left: 0.4rem;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--pn-accent);
  min-height: 2.4em;
}

@media (max-width: 820px) {
  .pn-desk { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .pn-win-term, .pn-win-nb { transform: none; }
  .pn-body { height: 250px; }
  .pn-pointer { display: none; }
}
</style>

<figure class="pn-stage" id="pn-stage">
  <div class="pn-bar">
    <div class="pn-step-label" id="pn-step-label"><span class="pn-num">1</span>Loading…</div>
    <div class="pn-dots" id="pn-dots" role="tablist" aria-label="Walkthrough steps"></div>
    <button class="pn-btn" id="pn-prev" type="button" aria-label="Previous step">◀</button>
    <button class="pn-btn" id="pn-play" type="button">⏸ Pause</button>
    <button class="pn-btn" id="pn-next" type="button" aria-label="Next step">▶</button>
    <button class="pn-btn" id="pn-replay" type="button">↻ Replay</button>
  </div>

  <div class="pn-desk" id="pn-desk">
    <div class="pn-win pn-win-term">
      <div class="pn-win-title"><span class="pn-lights"><i></i><i></i><i></i></span> Terminal — you and your tutor</div>
      <div class="pn-body pn-term-body" id="pn-term"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="pn-win pn-win-nb">
      <div class="pn-win-title"><span class="pn-lights"><i></i><i></i><i></i></span> Browser — your notebook</div>
      <div class="pn-body pn-nb-body" id="pn-nb"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="pn-pointer" id="pn-pointer">👆</div>
  </div>

  <figcaption class="pn-note" id="pn-note"></figcaption>
</figure>

<script>
(function () {
  const stage = document.getElementById("pn-stage");
  if (!stage) return;

  const term = document.getElementById("pn-term");
  const nb = document.getElementById("pn-nb");
  const desk = document.getElementById("pn-desk");
  const pointer = document.getElementById("pn-pointer");
  const label = document.getElementById("pn-step-label");
  const note = document.getElementById("pn-note");
  const dotsBox = document.getElementById("pn-dots");
  const btnPlay = document.getElementById("pn-play");

  const reduced = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;

  /* ---------- sequencer: abortable, pausable, fast-forwardable ---------- */
  const ABORT = Symbol("abort");
  let gen = 0;        // bumped on every restart/jump; stale scenes abort
  let paused = false; // = userPaused || offscreen
  let userPaused = false;
  let offscreen = false;
  let fast = false;   // true while fast-forwarding to a step
  const syncPause = () => { paused = userPaused || offscreen; };

  function sleep(ms) {
    if (fast) return Promise.resolve();
    const g = gen;
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      let left = ms;
      const slice = 40;
      const tick = () => {
        if (g !== gen) return reject(ABORT);
        if (paused) return setTimeout(tick, 90);
        left -= slice;
        left <= 0 ? resolve() : setTimeout(tick, slice);
      };
      setTimeout(tick, slice);
    });
  }

  function el(tag, cls, html) {
    const e = document.createElement(tag);
    if (cls) e.className = cls;
    if (html != null) e.innerHTML = html;
    return e;
  }
  const bottom = (box) => { box.scrollTop = box.scrollHeight; };

  async function type(target, text, speed) {
    if (fast) { target.textContent = text; bottom(target.closest(".pn-body")); return; }
    const box = target.closest(".pn-body");
    const caret = el("span", "pn-cursor");
    target.after(caret);
    for (const ch of text) {
      target.textContent += ch;
      bottom(box);
      await sleep(speed || 26);
    }
    caret.remove();
    bottom(box);
  }

  /* ---------- terminal ---------- */
  const WHO = { tutor: "tutor ›", you: "you ›" };
  async function say(who, text, speed) {
    const line = el("div", "pn-line pn-line-" + who);
    if (WHO[who]) line.appendChild(el("span", "pn-who", WHO[who]));
    const span = el("span");
    line.appendChild(span);
    term.appendChild(line);
    bottom(term);
    await type(span, text, speed);
    return line;
  }
  function flat(cls, text) {
    const line = el("div", "pn-line " + cls, text);
    term.appendChild(line);
    bottom(term);
    return line;
  }

  /* ---------- notebook ---------- */
  function cell(tag) {
    const c = el("div", "pn-cell");
    if (tag) c.appendChild(el("div", "pn-cell-tag", tag));
    nb.appendChild(c);
    bottom(nb);
    return c;
  }

  /* ---------- the pointing hand ---------- */
  function point(target, dx, dy) {
    if (fast || reduced) return;
    const a = target.getBoundingClientRect();
    const b = desk.getBoundingClientRect();
    pointer.style.transform =
      "translate(" + (a.left - b.left + a.width / 2 + (dx || 0)) + "px," +
      (a.top - b.top + a.height / 2 + (dy || 0)) + "px)";
    pointer.classList.add("pn-on");
  }
  const unpoint = () => pointer.classList.remove("pn-on");

  /* ---------- scenes ---------- */
  // Watts-Strogatz shape: path length collapses long before clustering does.
  const P_STEPS = 24;
  const L_RAT = [1, .99, .97, .93, .86, .75, .62, .48, .36, .27, .21, .17, .14, .12, .105, .095, .085, .078, .072, .067, .063, .059, .056, .053];
  const C_RAT = [1, 1, .99, .99, .98, .97, .96, .94, .92, .88, .83, .76, .67, .57, .46, .35, .26, .19, .13, .09, .06, .04, .026, .016];
  const px = (i) => 24 + (i / (P_STEPS - 1)) * 176;
  const py = (v) => 78 - v * 62;
  const poly = (arr) => arr.map((v, i) => px(i) + "," + py(v)).join(" ");
  const pval = (i) => Math.pow(10, -4 + (4 * i) / (P_STEPS - 1));

  const scenes = [
    {
      label: "You start the session",
      note: "One command inside your assignment folder. Your tutor opens the notebook for you — there is nothing else to launch.",
      async run() {
        await say("cmd", "$ pi", 55);
        await sleep(500);
        flat("pn-line-sys", "starting notebook · opening your browser…");
        await sleep(700);
        const c = cell("cell 1");
        c.appendChild(el("div", "pn-cell-title", "Pair Notebook 02 — The Small-World Puzzle"));
        c.appendChild(el("div", "pn-cap", "Your notebook starts empty. You two fill it together."));
        await sleep(600);
        await say("tutor", "Hi! I'm your tutor for Module 02. Pen and paper ready?");
        await sleep(300);
        await say("you", "ready", 70);
      }
    },
    {
      label: "Your tutor asks — you answer",
      note: "All the talking happens in the terminal: predictions, explanations, guesses. Your words are logged verbatim, exactly as you wrote them.",
      async run() {
        await sleep(300);
        await say("tutor", "Four people in a room, everyone shakes hands once. How many handshakes? Guess before you count.");
        await sleep(900);
        await say("you", "6?", 90);
        await sleep(400);
        await say("tutor", "That's it. Let's put it on the whiteboard →");
      }
    },
    {
      label: "The notebook draws it",
      note: "The notebook is the whiteboard: figures, animations, anything the terminal cannot show. It is built one cell at a time, in front of you.",
      async run() {
        await sleep(250);
        const c = cell("cell 2");
        c.appendChild(el("div", "pn-cell-title", "4 people, 6 pairs"));
        const svg = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "svg");
        svg.setAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 220 140");
        svg.setAttribute("class", "pn-svg");
        const pts = [[45, 32], [175, 32], [175, 112], [45, 112]];
        const pairs = [[0, 1], [1, 2], [2, 3], [3, 0], [0, 2], [1, 3]];
        pairs.forEach((pr, i) => {
          const ln = document.createElementNS(svg.namespaceURI, "line");
          ln.setAttribute("x1", pts[pr[0]][0]); ln.setAttribute("y1", pts[pr[0]][1]);
          ln.setAttribute("x2", pts[pr[1]][0]); ln.setAttribute("y2", pts[pr[1]][1]);
          ln.setAttribute("class", "pn-edge");
          ln.style.animationDelay = (fast ? 0 : 0.35 + i * 0.28) + "s";
          svg.appendChild(ln);
        });
        pts.forEach((p, i) => {
          const ci = document.createElementNS(svg.namespaceURI, "circle");
          ci.setAttribute("cx", p[0]); ci.setAttribute("cy", p[1]); ci.setAttribute("r", 11);
          ci.setAttribute("class", "pn-node");
          ci.style.animationDelay = (fast ? 0 : i * 0.09) + "s";
          svg.appendChild(ci);
        });
        c.appendChild(svg);
        c.appendChild(el("div", "pn-cap", "Every pair joined once: 4 × 3 / 2 = 6 edges."));
        bottom(nb);
        await sleep(2600);
        await say("tutor", "✓ Checkpoint 1 logged — in your words, not mine.");
      }
    },
    {
      label: "You get a knob to turn",
      note: "Some cells are live experiments. Turn the knob, watch what moves, and tell your tutor what you saw — that sentence is the checkpoint.",
      async run() {
        await sleep(250);
        const c = cell("cell 3");
        c.appendChild(el("div", "pn-cell-title", "Rewire a ring, one edge at a time"));
        const wrap = el("div", "pn-slider");
        const track = el("div", "pn-track");
        const knob = el("div", "pn-knob");
        track.appendChild(knob);
        wrap.appendChild(track);
        const read = el("div", "pn-readout",
          '<span>p = <b id="pn-p">0.0001</b></span>' +
          '<span style="color:var(--pn-accent)">path length <b id="pn-L">1.00</b></span>' +
          '<span style="color:var(--pn-amber)">clustering <b id="pn-C">1.00</b></span>');
        wrap.appendChild(read);
        const svg = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "svg");
        svg.setAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 214 96");
        svg.setAttribute("class", "pn-svg");
        svg.innerHTML =
          '<line class="pn-axis" x1="22" y1="80" x2="206" y2="80"/>' +
          '<line class="pn-axis" x1="22" y1="10" x2="22" y2="80"/>' +
          '<polyline class="pn-curve-C" points="' + poly(C_RAT) + '"/>' +
          '<polyline class="pn-curve-L" points="' + poly(L_RAT) + '"/>' +
          '<line class="pn-marker" id="pn-mark" x1="24" y1="8" x2="24" y2="82"/>' +
          '<text class="pn-nolabel" x="22" y="93">p = 0.0001</text>' +
          '<text class="pn-nolabel" x="176" y="93">p = 1</text>';
        wrap.appendChild(svg);
        c.appendChild(wrap);
        c.appendChild(el("div", "pn-cap", "Drag it and watch which curve falls first."));
        bottom(nb);

        await sleep(700);
        point(knob, 0, 26);
        await sleep(700);
        for (let i = 0; i <= P_STEPS - 1; i++) {
          knob.style.left = ((i / (P_STEPS - 1)) * 100) + "%";
          document.getElementById("pn-p").textContent = pval(i).toFixed(4);
          document.getElementById("pn-L").textContent = L_RAT[i].toFixed(2);
          document.getElementById("pn-C").textContent = C_RAT[i].toFixed(2);
          const m = document.getElementById("pn-mark");
          m.setAttribute("x1", px(i)); m.setAttribute("x2", px(i));
          if (!fast) point(knob, 0, 26);
          await sleep(105);
        }
        unpoint();
        await sleep(500);
        await say("tutor", "So — what fell first?");
        await sleep(500);
        await say("you", "the path length crashes way before the clustering does", 34);
        await sleep(400);
        const n = cell("note");
        n.appendChild(el("div", "pn-quote", "“the path length crashes way before the clustering does”"));
        n.appendChild(el("div", "pn-cap", "— your answer, checkpoint 4, quoted word for word"));
        bottom(nb);
      }
    },
    {
      label: "You photograph your paper",
      note: "Three steps happen off-screen, on real paper: a distance table, a drawing, a derivation. Photograph each with your phone, drop it in, press 📨 Send to my tutor.",
      async run() {
        await sleep(250);
        await say("tutor", "Now do it by hand. Fill in the distance table on paper, then photograph it.");
        await sleep(500);
        const c = cell("cell 4");
        c.appendChild(el("div", "pn-cell-title", "📷 Your distance table"));
        const drop = el("div", "pn-drop", '<span class="pn-hint">drop a photo of your paper here</span>');
        const photo = el("div", "pn-photo");
        photo.innerHTML =
          '<svg viewBox="0 0 120 84" class="pn-svg" aria-label="a photo of a handwritten table">' +
          '<rect x="0" y="0" width="120" height="84" fill="#fffbe9"/>' +
          '<path d="M12 20 H108 M12 36 H108 M12 52 H108 M12 68 H108" stroke="#9c95b5" stroke-width="1"/>' +
          '<path d="M40 12 V76 M68 12 V76 M92 12 V76" stroke="#9c95b5" stroke-width="1"/>' +
          '<path d="M18 30 q6 -8 10 0 M50 30 q5 -7 9 1 M76 29 q7 -6 10 2 M100 31 q4 -8 8 0" stroke="#2c2a3a" stroke-width="2.1" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>' +
          '<path d="M18 46 q7 -7 11 1 M50 47 q4 -9 9 0 M78 45 q5 -6 8 3 M100 47 q6 -7 8 1" stroke="#2c2a3a" stroke-width="2.1" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>' +
          '<path d="M19 63 q5 -8 10 1 M52 62 q6 -6 8 2 M77 63 q6 -8 9 1 M101 62 q5 -7 8 2" stroke="#2c2a3a" stroke-width="2.1" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>' +
          "</svg>";
        drop.appendChild(photo);
        c.appendChild(drop);
        const send = el("div", "pn-send", "📨 Send to my tutor");
        c.appendChild(send);
        bottom(nb);

        await sleep(600);
        photo.classList.add("pn-in");
        drop.classList.add("pn-filled");
        await sleep(900);
        point(send, 6, 16);
        await sleep(650);
        send.classList.add("pn-press");
        await sleep(320);
        send.classList.remove("pn-press");
        send.classList.add("pn-done");
        send.textContent = "✓ sent";
        unpoint();
        await sleep(400);
        await say("tutor", "Got it. Rows 1–3 check out. Row 4 counts one pair twice — want another look?");
        await sleep(600);
        await say("you", "oh — i double counted B–D", 40);
      }
    },
    {
      label: "You hand it in from the terminal",
      note: "Nothing to upload by hand, no file to email. Tell your tutor you are done and it commits the session to your GitHub Classroom repository.",
      async run() {
        await sleep(250);
        await say("you", "that's me done for today — hand it in", 34);
        await sleep(500);
        await say("tutor", "Handing in your notebook, your log and the summary.");
        await sleep(400);
        flat("pn-line-cmd", "$ git add -A && git commit -m \"Pair Notebook 02\" && git push");
        await sleep(900);
        flat("pn-line-ok", "✓ pushed to your Classroom repository — 12 checkpoints, 1h 12m");
        await sleep(500);
        const c = cell("cell 12");
        c.appendChild(el("div", "pn-cell-title", "Session record"));
        const ul = el("ul", "pn-rec");
        ["notebook.py — your illustrated lecture note",
         "session_log.jsonl — every answer, verbatim",
         "session_summary.md — for your instructor"].forEach((t) => {
          ul.appendChild(el("li", null, '<span class="pn-tick">✓</span> ' + t));
        });
        c.appendChild(ul);
        c.appendChild(el("div", "pn-cap", "Stopping halfway is fine — pick it up tomorrow and hand in again."));
        bottom(nb);
        await sleep(2200);
      }
    }
  ];

  /* ---------- dots ---------- */
  scenes.forEach((s, i) => {
    const d = el("button", "pn-dot");
    d.type = "button";
    d.title = i + 1 + ". " + s.label;
    d.setAttribute("aria-label", "Step " + (i + 1) + ": " + s.label);
    d.addEventListener("click", () => jump(i));
    dotsBox.appendChild(d);
  });
  const dots = Array.from(dotsBox.children);

  function mark(i) {
    label.innerHTML = '<span class="pn-num">' + (i + 1) + "</span>" + scenes[i].label;
    note.textContent = scenes[i].note;
    dots.forEach((d, k) => d.setAttribute("aria-current", k === i ? "true" : "false"));
  }

  function clear() {
    term.textContent = "";
    nb.textContent = "";
    unpoint();
  }

  let current = 0;

  async function play(from) {
    const g = ++gen;
    clear();
    try {
      for (let i = 0; i < scenes.length; i++) {
        if (g !== gen) return;
        fast = i < from;
        current = i;
        if (!fast) mark(i);
        await scenes[i].run();
      }
      fast = false;
      await sleep(2400);
      if (g === gen) play(0);          // loop
    } catch (e) {
      if (e !== ABORT) throw e;
    }
  }

  function jump(i) {
    userPaused = false;
    syncPause();
    btnPlay.textContent = "⏸ Pause";
    play(Math.max(0, Math.min(scenes.length - 1, i)));
  }

  document.getElementById("pn-replay").addEventListener("click", () => jump(0));
  document.getElementById("pn-prev").addEventListener("click", () => jump(current - 1));
  document.getElementById("pn-next").addEventListener("click", () => jump(current + 1));
  btnPlay.addEventListener("click", () => {
    userPaused = !userPaused;
    syncPause();
    btnPlay.textContent = userPaused ? "▶ Play" : "⏸ Pause";
  });

  if (reduced) {
    // No motion: build the whole thing at once and leave it there.
    (async () => {
      const g = ++gen;
      clear();
      fast = true;
      for (const s of scenes) { if (g !== gen) return; await s.run(); }
      fast = false;
      current = scenes.length - 1;
      mark(current);
      userPaused = true;
      syncPause();
      btnPlay.textContent = "▶ Play";
    })();
  } else {
    // Play from the top; idle while scrolled out of view so nothing is missed.
    if (window.IntersectionObserver) {
      new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach((en) => { offscreen = !en.isIntersecting; syncPause(); });
      }, { threshold: 0.2 }).observe(stage);
    }
    jump(0);
  }
})();
</script>
```
